title: E2E: wiremock end-to-end initialization + SSE sequence
description:
What: End-to-end integration test using wiremock to verify the full KITH-qvdl initialization sequence: session fetch -> Chat/get -> Contact/get -> Message/query -> Message/get -> SSE state change -> Message/changes -> state.messages updated.

Algorithm:
1. Start wiremock MockServer.
2. Mount mocks:
   a. GET /.well-known/jmap -> ClientSession JSON with api_url, event_source_url, primaryAccounts: {"urn:kith:chat:1":"a-self"}.
   b. POST /jmap/api (Chat/get call) -> {methodResponses:[["Chat/get",{accountId:"a-self",list:[{id:"chat-abc",kind:"direct",participants:["c-1"],unreadCount:1,createdAt:"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}],state:"s-3"},"c0"],["Contact/get",{accountId:"a-self",list:[{id:"c-1",login:"bob@x.com"}],state:"s-2"},"c1"]],sessionState:"s-1"}.
   c. POST /jmap/api (Message/query call) -> {methodResponses:[["Message/query",{accountId:"a-self",queryState:"s-3",ids:["m-1"],position:0},"mq0"]],sessionState:"s-1"}.
   d. POST /jmap/api (Message/get call) -> {methodResponses:[["Message/get",{accountId:"a-self",list:[{id:"m-1",chatId:"chat-abc",senderId:"c-1",body:"Hello world",bodyType:"text/plain",attachments:[],sentAt:"2026-04-19T10:00:00Z",receivedAt:"2026-04-19T10:00:01Z",deliveryState:"received"}],state:"s-3"},"mg0"]],sessionState:"s-1"}.
   e. POST /jmap/api (Message/changes call) -> {methodResponses:[["Message/changes",{accountId:"a-self",oldState:"s-3",newState:"s-4",hasMoreChanges:false,created:["m-2"],updated:[],destroyed:[]},"mc0"]],sessionState:"s-1"}.
   f. POST /jmap/api (second Message/get) -> {methodResponses:[["Message/get",{accountId:"a-self",list:[{id:"m-2",chatId:"chat-abc",senderId:"self",body:"Reply",bodyType:"text/plain",attachments:[],sentAt:"2026-04-19T10:01:00Z",receivedAt:"2026-04-19T10:01:00Z",deliveryState:"pending"}],state:"s-4"},"mg0"]],sessionState:"s-1"}.
3. Run initialization sequence: fetch_session -> call_jmap(Chat/get+Contact/get) -> call_jmap(Message/query) -> call_jmap(Message/get).
4. Assert after init: state.chat_list=["bob@x.com (1)"], state.chat_ids=["chat-abc"], state.messages contains "10:00:01 bob@x.com: Hello world" (or similar format).
5. Simulate SSE StateChange: send StateChange{type_name:"Message",new_state:"s-4"} on sse_tx.
6. Run Message/changes + Message/get sequence.
7. Assert state.messages now also contains "10:01:00 me: Reply"; state.message_state=="s-4".

Defensive rules:
- All assertions use explicit expected strings derived from mock data (never from the code under test).
- Test is async (#[tokio::test]).

Agent team: R reads existing wiremock tests in client.rs for patterns; T writes the full test (this is a test-only bead); V runs cargo test -p kith-tui.

Tests: this bead IS the test. Pass condition: all assertions green; no panics.
